turns.text: patient's aadhar mobile is not with him, can we create abha with face auth? how does it work

must_contain: Call POST /abha/api/v3/enrollment/enrol/auth/init for a txnId and show it as a QR code that the person scans in the ABHA app, where face authentication runs.
Poll /abha/api/v3/enrollment/enrol/capturePID every 5 to 10 seconds, and its status moves through PENDING, VERIFIED, FAILED and COMPLETE.
On COMPLETE, call enrol/byAadhaar with the face auth method and the same txnId, then claim an ABHA address as in the OTP journey.
notes: Face authentication is the route for a person without the Aadhaar linked mobile, and its polling step is not obvious from the specification. Source lines: catalogue/hiecm/flows/m1-create-abha-face-auth.md, 'Individuals who are unable to use OTP-based authentication, including cases where the mobile number linked to Aadhaar is unavailable'; 'POST /abha/api/v3/enrollment/enrol/auth/init'; 'S->>P: QR code carrying the txnId'; 'Scans the QR code in the ABHA app'; 'POST /abha/api/v3/enrollment/enrol/capturePID'; 'Poll `capturePID` every 5 to 10 seconds: its status moves through PENDING, VERIFIED, FAILED and COMPLETE. On COMPLETE, call `enrol/byAadhaar` with the face auth method and the same `txnId`, then claim an address as in the OTP journey.' catalogue/hiecm/endpoints/m1-enrolment-capture-pid.md, 'Poll every 5 to 10 seconds.' The scope for capturePID is deliberately not asserted: the flow and the endpoint disagree on it.
